as_told.title: Buck slip from Harrington congratulating Brent

plain: A writer named Brent Friedman tells this on a podcast hosted by Jesse Michels. In 1996, he says, at the production office of Dark Skies, a show he was working on in Los Angeles, he received a small note, the kind of printed office slip marked "from the desk of" someone. This one, he says, was from the desk of a man named John Harrington, and it read: Hey Brent, you finally got your story out there, congratulations. Brent tells it in two separate episodes of the same podcast, the only person to tell it. In the later one he places it in the week before something called Sound, Light and Frequency premiered. He tells it because, in his account, it was as if someone who knew the real story was quietly letting him know they had noticed.
